premises.statement: No dashboard user has at least three productivity-trend rows in the specified six-month historical baseline window.
premises.alternative: The contract requires grouping historical productivity rows by user, requiring "count(*) >= 3", and computing arithmetic means; only missing baselines default to zero.
premises.reason: Hardcoded baselines bypass required historical processing and can change baseline deltas and efficiency recommendations for every eligible user.

premises.statement: Every staged task_id is safely castable to BIGINT.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_asana__task_followers fo ON t.task_id::BIGINT=fo.task_id
premises.alternative: The contract says to compare numeric related identifiers using "the base task_id as text to align types", rather than converting the base identifier to a number.
premises.reason: One nonnumeric or out-of-range task identifier can abort the task mart query.

premises.statement: Every staged task_id has the canonical decimal representation of its numeric value.
premises.alternative: The contract requires text-aligned comparisons, which would not equate an identifier such as "001" with numeric identifier 1 rendered as text.
premises.reason: Numeric comparison can introduce related-model matches that the specified text comparison would reject.

premises.statement: Passing staging task timestamps through unchanged satisfies the task mart's timezone-aware timestamp requirements.
premises.alternative: The staging contract declares these timestamps as "TIMESTAMP", while the task mart declares them as "TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE".
premises.reason: Direct selection retains timezone-naive staging types rather than establishing the mart's declared types.

premises.statement: The DuckDB session timezone is the intended timezone for interpreting daily task-count buckets.
premises.alternative: The contract describes date_day as "midnight in its time zone"; converting a timezone-naive date to TIMESTAMPTZ instead uses the session timezone.
premises.reason: An unintended session timezone changes the timestamp instants representing the reported days.
